name: A Missing Hand
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.

I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
narrative.objectives: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
narrative.offerRewardText: Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.Whatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.
